criterion: Rank observed chunks by relevance to the active observed failure.

fallback.action: Use the complete observed chunk set through the original manual debugging path.

agentDuties: Inspect anomalies and form and test root-cause hypotheses.
Trace evidence upstream and downstream and retain lower-ranked evidence when needed.
finalVerification: Reproduce the failure, establish a failing check, fix one root cause, and rerun affected checks.
